timing: Written after the lock and BEFORE any implementation code or verification run of NP-MISSION-INTEGRATION (no result has been seen). The prereg files are not edited (CC-01).

item.subject: FT-10 scope (no RFP threshold)
item.finding: FT-10 says the integration reads no file under config/requirements, config/constraints or config/assessment, asserted on the hook's file list. The admitted environment loader the hook must call (abep_data::pins::FrozenPins, SC-WP-01, used by abep_atmos::execution) reads config/constraints/engineering_constraints_v1.json for one value only: constraints.altitude_band_km, the mission-domain altitude band that validates the frozen design-state set (A9.22 G5; mission_scenario_v2 revision note: 'the altitude band is a frozen domain constraint validating the frozen 196-state design-state set'). It is a domain-validity check inside the admitted environment layer, not a requirement threshold applied to raw mission physics, and no value of it reaches the mission record.
item.clarification: FT-10 is evaluated as three assertions, all required: (a) abep_mission::integration::integrate reads no file at all (pure function of its typed inputs); (b) the hook's declared file list contains no file under config/requirements or config/assessment; (c) the only config/constraints file on the hook's list is config/constraints/engineering_constraints_v1.json, attributed to the environment layer's altitude-band domain pin, and no mission-record value is derived from it.
item.effect: No criterion is relaxed for the mission model itself; (a) is stricter than the original wording. The environment layer's admitted behaviour is not changed (one authoritative implementation).
